name: NFSMW-Upper Radar / replica from NFS:MW 2005
description: The radar detector under the mirror from NFS:MW 2005, warning of trouble on the track ahead: a car stopped, crawling, going backwards or stranded off the track. As in the game, every pulse the bar goes dark and fills again from the dome, with a beep: seldom while the trouble is far, more often the closer it is. The arrow points to it.

settings.label: Fast pulses closer than
settings.description: Closer than this the bar pulses often, more often still as the trouble nears.

settings.label: Pulses closer than
settings.description: Closer than this the bar pulses slowly; further away (up to 1000 m) it pulses seldom.

settings.label: Arrow to the trouble
settings.description: The arrow in the dome points to the trouble (iRacing and Le Mans Ultimate); elsewhere it points ahead.

settings.label: Brighter side of the trouble
settings.description: The lights on the side of the trouble burn brighter than the other side (iRacing and Le Mans Ultimate). Off: both sides burn the same.

settings.label: Only while driving
settings.description: Hidden in the garage, in a replay and while the game is paused, as in the game; off: always shown.

settings.label: Beep
settings.description: The game's radar beep with every pulse. Silent while the layout is edited and inside Racelink's window (previews, clips).

settings.label: Sound in demo
settings.description: Beep in demo mode too (on the game's screen or in a browser; Racelink's own window stays silent).
